primary_authorities.title: FTC: Protecting personal information
primary_authorities.summary: Identify personal data, limit collection and retention, protect it, and plan for incidents. A privacy notice alone does not verify operating controls.

primary_authorities.title: European Commission: GDPR application
primary_authorities.summary: GDPR applicability depends on establishment and offering goods or services to, or monitoring, people in the EU; location of the operator alone is insufficient.

primary_authorities.title: European Commission: international transfers
primary_authorities.summary: Transfers subject to GDPR need an applicable legal route and safeguards; a published policy is not an executed transfer arrangement.

primary_authorities.title: Iowa Code 715D (2026)
primary_authorities.summary: Determine whether Iowa consumer-data thresholds and exclusions apply using actual processing volumes and activities; preserve the applicable consumer rights and response process.

primary_authorities.title: California Attorney General: CCPA
primary_authorities.summary: Assess statutory coverage, exceptions and consumer rights against actual business and processing facts. No California applicability determination has been recorded here.

primary_authorities.title: ICO: subject access
primary_authorities.summary: UK rights requests require the applicable response process; operational identity checks, search capability and deadlines must be assigned.

primary_authorities.title: ICO: data-protection complaints
primary_authorities.summary: The UK complaints process now requires acknowledgment within 30 days, investigation without undue delay, progress information and outcome information where applicable.

primary_authorities.title: European Commission: AI Act
primary_authorities.summary: Classify the actual AI role and intended use. Prohibited practices and AI literacy already apply; the Commission describes separate high-risk timelines. Recheck the enacted rules for the intended deployment.

primary_authorities.title: European Commission: Article 50 guidelines
primary_authorities.summary: Transparency obligations for covered AI systems and generated content apply from 2 August 2026. Identify applicable notices and marking duties for the actual role and content.

primary_authorities.title: W3C: WCAG 2.2
primary_authorities.summary: Use WCAG 2.2 as a technical assessment reference. Test each complete user journey, including keyboard, assistive technology, mobile and authentication; this record is not a conformance claim.

primary_authorities.title: EU: European Accessibility Act
primary_authorities.summary: Determine covered products and services, national implementation, timing and any fact-supported exemption; the Directive includes e-commerce services and specific microenterprise provisions.

primary_authorities.title: OFAC: Framework for Compliance Commitments
primary_authorities.summary: A risk-based sanctions program includes management commitment, risk assessment, controls, testing and training. Assess parties, ownership, activities and relevant jurisdictions, rather than relying on a country selector.

primary_authorities.title: OFAC: Sanctions List Service
primary_authorities.summary: Use current authoritative sanctions data in the applicable screening process. Listing a country in the UI does not authorize a transaction.

primary_authorities.title: BIS: encryption controls
primary_authorities.summary: Assess EAR jurisdiction, encryption classification, end use, end user, destination and any applicable exception, notification or reporting for the actual exported software and technology.

primary_authorities.title: BIS: encryption items not subject to EAR
primary_authorities.summary: Public availability and source licensing do not themselves establish every encryption exclusion; confirm the exact classification, notification and publication conditions.

primary_authorities.title: FTC: Advertising and marketing
primary_authorities.summary: Advertising claims and endorsements need truthful support; do not promote approvals, protection or capability beyond their evidence and scope.

primary_authorities.title: FTC: CAN-SPAM guide
primary_authorities.summary: Commercial email requires the applicable sender, content, address and opt-out controls. Other regions and channels can have separate consent and marketing requirements.

primary_authorities.title: FinCEN: convertible virtual-currency business models
primary_authorities.summary: Money-services obligations depend on the actual activity and business model. Software development and owner approval do not authorize money transmission, exchange or custody.

primary_authorities.title: ESMA: MiCA rulebook
primary_authorities.summary: Classify the actual token, issuer and service and verify the named authorized party and permitted activities before regulated EU work; a general readiness record is not authorization.

primary_authorities.title: FCA: cryptoassets marketed to UK consumers
primary_authorities.summary: UK cryptoasset promotions can include websites, apps and social media, including communications by overseas firms. Establish the lawful communication route and required safeguards before promotion.

primary_authorities.title: Singapore PDPC: data-protection obligations
primary_authorities.summary: Assess notification, accountability, protection, retention, access and transfer obligations for the proposed processing and local role.

primary_authorities.title: MAS: Payment Services Act
primary_authorities.summary: Match the actual payment or digital-token activity to the current licensing framework and named provider permissions; no MAS permission for Numina is established here.

primary_authorities.title: Hong Kong PCPD: six data-protection principles
primary_authorities.summary: Map personal-data collection, use, retention, security, transparency and access to the actual Hong Kong activity and the Ordinance.

primary_authorities.title: Hong Kong SFC: licensing requirements
primary_authorities.summary: Assess the exact regulated service, trading/custody model and client targeting; an application or overseas approval is not a Hong Kong activity permission.

primary_authorities.title: Japan PPC: laws and policies
primary_authorities.summary: Use the current APPI text and guidance to assess the actual operator, processing and transfer arrangements; local applicability and provider evidence remain unreviewed.

primary_authorities.title: Australia OAIC: Australian Privacy Principles
primary_authorities.summary: Assess Privacy Act coverage and collection, security, transparency, access and overseas-disclosure duties for the actual arrangement, including exceptions supported by facts.

primary_authorities.title: Dubai VARA: licensed activities
primary_authorities.summary: Identify the activity and exact location. VARA regulates covered virtual-asset activities in or from Dubai excluding DIFC; other locations and financial free zones require their own assessment.

primary_authorities.title: IRS: business structures
primary_authorities.summary: An LLC is a state-law structure with tax treatment determined by applicable facts and elections. Confirm the actual entity and tax status rather than inferring it from the brand.

primary_authorities.title: IRS: international business
primary_authorities.summary: Assess international reporting, withholding, treaty and tax obligations against actual counterparties, workers, assets and operations; this is not tax clearance for every market.

primary_authorities.title: Iowa Secretary of State: business FAQs
primary_authorities.summary: Verify the actual legal entity, good-standing and name records and any required operating filings; separate Iowa formation from authority in another jurisdiction.

primary_authorities.title: US Department of Labor: worker misclassification
primary_authorities.summary: Worker classification depends on the actual relationship under applicable rules. A title or contractor label does not establish lawful classification; local labor and payroll rules also need review.

primary_authorities.title: FTC: data-breach response
primary_authorities.summary: Prepare containment, investigation and notifications to affected parties and authorities where required. Determine the applicable deadlines and recipient obligations for the actual incident.

primary_authorities.title: CISA: business logging
primary_authorities.summary: Protect logs, define retention and monitoring procedures, and designate response roles covering technology, communications, legal and business continuity.

primary_authorities.title: ISO: certification
primary_authorities.summary: Certification is assurance from an independent body. A control mapping, source test or policy publication is not an ISO certificate.

primary_authorities.title: FTC: cyber insurance
primary_authorities.summary: Review actual policy coverage, exclusions, limits, response arrangements and required safeguards; an intake or intended purchase is not bound coverage.

primary_authorities.title: USPTO: trademark process
primary_authorities.summary: Trademark registration requires the applicable search, application and examination process. A claimed mark or company name does not establish worldwide clearance or registration.

primary_authorities.title: USPTO: provisional applications
primary_authorities.summary: A provisional filing has requirements and a limited term and is not a patent grant; assess ownership, disclosure and filing strategy with the actual invention evidence.

primary_authorities.title: US Copyright Office: computer programs
primary_authorities.summary: Copyright registration for computer programs requires the appropriate claim and deposit; source ownership statements do not prove a registration or assignment chain.

primary_authorities.title: US Copyright Office: AI copyrightability
primary_authorities.summary: Assess human authorship and the actual AI contribution before claiming exclusive rights in generated material; a synthetic portrait is not evidence of a real human officer.

primary_authorities.title: Apple: App Review Guidelines
primary_authorities.summary: Native submissions need accurate metadata, lawful business behavior, privacy/security and third-party SDK compliance; source updates do not update an installed or approved binary.

primary_authorities.title: Google Play: User Data
primary_authorities.summary: Assess actual app and SDK data practices, disclosures, policy links and required account-deletion behavior; store availability requires an actual reviewed release and account evidence.

primary_authorities.title: Google: Android SDK agreement
primary_authorities.summary: Actual SDK terms and accepted account authority are separate from open-source component rights.

primary_authorities.title: Apple: SDK/developer agreements
primary_authorities.summary: Use and distribution require applicable actual accepted agreements; system framework rights are not a Numina BSD grant.
